title: script_set: schema allows only ok:true but registry returns ok:false with as-unknown cast
description: Fixed in commit 2ed7184: script_set now always saves the script (Flash 8 parity), returns ok:true with diagnostics even when errors are present. The ScriptSetResultSchema keeps ok:literal(true). The MCP tool description was updated to remove the misleading 'WITHOUT blocking the write' clause. The as-unknown cast was removed.
